name: Rachel Lang
reason: Her YouTube channel (@therachellangshow, The Rachel Lang Show) carries a run of political commentary in astrological form: the Epstein files with forecasts for Bill Clinton's and Trump's charts and the Democratic Party, 'Is Netanyahu Alive?' with dated 'health and attack' risk windows for him, the Iran conflict, and USA/NATO. Under the brief's YouTube rule (conspiracy or partisan political commentary) she is skipped; this is a judgement call the lead may overturn. Otherwise she nearly qualified: base Ojai, California (her about page), email published, Psychic Mediumship Certification starting 28 Jan 2027, membership, book Modern Day Magic confirmed on Open Library (ISBN 1784884618). Her Classes page lists a 7-week intuitive-astrology course linked through a Shift Network affiliate redirect (shiftnetwork.isrefer.com), not a theshiftnetwork.com URL; theshiftnetwork.com refuses our fetches (403, 4 Nov 2026).
